Meet Bizzy.
Your business assistant.

You shouldn’t need to search through reports just to understand your business. Ask Bizzy in normal language to find information and prepare your next step.

Demonstration only. Sales and customer questions start with Basic; supplier and bookkeeping help require Business; stock help requires Complete. Workspace availability applies.

Bizzy helps find information and prepare work. Actions that create or change financial or stock records are shown for your review and explicit confirmation before they are completed. Payment reminders are drafts for manual sharing. Bizzy does not replace your accountant or provide regulated professional advice.
